provenance.massGeometrySteering: Manufacturer 2021 Pacifica Hybrid specifications pp. 2-4, at curb weight with standard equipment. Not the actual occupied/instrumented MnCAV.
provenance.lfLr: Derived from stock wheelbase and static front/rear load fractions: lf=L*rearFraction, lr=L*frontFraction.
provenance.yawInertia: Uniform rectangular planform prior m*(length^2+width^2)/12; not measured MnCAV inertia.
provenance.corneringStiffness: Unidentified nominal prior retained from existing MnCAV calibration report: legacy 75000/56000 N/rad scaled by 2273/1575. Not manufacturer specifications or validated tire identification.
provenance.actualLoadedMass: Unknown: no payload, occupancy or sensor-rack mass is invented.
provenance.sensorNoiseDelay: Not vehicle specifications; must be sourced from sensor/registration characterization or explicitly declared synthetic assumptions.
